4279-6094-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6094-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1170-1477-1594-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-1594-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

Activate Woodland Weavemaster using the ability granted to it by Presence of Gond by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters, Woodland Weavemaster triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Woodland Weavemaster using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on Woodland Weavemaster, untapping Woodland Weavemaster.
Repeat.

206-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

140-3245-6731.description:
Activate Deepwood Ghoul by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

206-1069-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
206-1069-2457-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

2757-4629-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping The Incredible Hulk, untapping a basic Mountain.
Repeat from step 2.

856-1477-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1020-2866-5231-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1020-2866-5231-6747.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Repeat.

Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.

Repeat.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Walking Ballista resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Frog and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4067-6604-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6604-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

560-1940-3967-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-3967-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Repeat.

Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.

Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.

"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1849-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate the Razortide Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1409-3447-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Tishana is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
You control an artifact, creature, or land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1409-3447-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Tishana by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Tishana enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Tishana trigger, causing you to draw a card for each creature you control.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Tishana.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
If you control additional creatures and/or the mana-producing permanent produces at least {1}{U}, this combo nets near-infinite mana and near-infinite card draw.
